description: Go 1.27.1 official platform archive. Manual only because the coarse v1 platform predicate cannot enforce the documented OS/kernel floor.
purpose: Offer a pinned Go toolchain artifact for explicitly selected projects while preserving any existing Go version and module files.
detection: Before proposing, inspect only the participant-approved project go.mod go/toolchain declarations and current go version. If the installed version satisfies the project declaration, do not select this recipe. Confirm the vendor floor (Linux x86-64; Go download page states Linux kernel 3.2 or later); unknown OS/kernel version means manual/unmet. Do not edit go.mod, go.sum, or the module cache.
license_notes: Go is distributed under its BSD-style license. The Go distribution may contain separately licensed components; preserve and review bundled notices. This recipe does not repackage the artifact.
side_effects: No automated extraction or installation is supported by this record.
A participant-selected manual install must use an explicit side-by-side destination and must not replace an existing Go installation or alter project module files.
verification: Manual/unmet until the OS/kernel floor is known and satisfied. After a separately approved side-by-side install, run the explicit executable with version reporting and verify it matches the project declaration before selecting it.
